review.headline: Tempo abandoned at 6 km of 9 planned; calf pain and RPE 9 suggest stopping was right.
observations: Planned 2 km warm-up, 5 km tempo at 4:37/km, 2 km cool-down; ran 6.0 km in 33:40 at 5:37/km avg.
Warm-up was too fast for an easy block: laps 1 at 5:50/km with HR 150, against the 5:11-6:13/km easy range sitting at the slow end.
Tempo block was run at 5:00/km (laps 2, km 3-5), about 23 s/km faster than the 4:37/km target, with HR 176 avg and max 179, so the intended controlled effort was never held.
Only about 3 km was at tempo-range effort before the run ended, and the final km slowed to 7:00/km at HR 158-159, consistent with stopping early.
flags: Sharp calf pain since Tuesday, reported in the athlete's note: prioritize assessing this before any further running.
RPE 9 on a session meant to be comfortably hard.
Pace overshoot into tempo and HR near max (179) in a session that should have been controlled.
Previous tempo on 2026-11-03 was run at 4:37/km for 4 km with HR 161, so this session deviated from a recent pattern that was on target.
